name: The Medical Debt Biomarker
debt: A child or sibling suffers from a chronic illness, and their life-sustaining biopolymer medication was transferred to a high-risk corporate loan with compound daily interest.
threat: If their personal Credit Rating dips below Tier-D or they fail to make weekly credit payments, the pharma-conglomerate turns off the remote dosage dispenser.

name: Off-Grid Family Eviction Notice
debt: The character’s elderly parents or family were evicted from a privatized corporate urban arcology and forced into an unsanctioned squatters’ ghetto.
threat: Private security sweeps are scheduled to clear the sector with heavy industrial equipment. The character needs enough cash to buy an entry-level residency permit in a protected zone.

name: Repossession of a Dead Parent's Organ
debt: A deceased relative took out a high-interest lease on a synthetic heart or kidney, and the character co-signed the liability contract.
threat: Repo-teams are actively tracking the family. To prevent the gruesome physical reclamation of the implant (and the associated public humiliation and bio-clean fees), the character must pay off the defaulted principal.

name: Black-Market AR Biometric Cleanse
debt: The character was framed for a corporate industrial espionage crime, leaving them flagged on every municipal facial-recognition grid and public AR camera.
threat: Their current identity is a rented/borrowed biometric spool that costs exorbitant daily maintenance fees from a back-alley bio-hacker to keep from expiring.

name: Buyback of a Corporate Indentured Sibling
debt: A younger sibling signed a 10-year indentured labor contract with an off-shore industrial recycler to pay off family inheritance taxes.
threat: Reports from the refinery show high mortality rates. The buyout clause in the contract is astronomically high, requiring immediate, liquid credits before the term ends.

name: The Predatory Education Lien
debt: The character attended a corporate-sponsored vocational academy, incurring a specialized predatory loan that garnishes 80% of all legal income.
threat: Working a standard, legal job will never clear the interest. Only off-the-books, high-risk mercenary work provides unmonitored cash to pay down the principal under the radar.

name: Hostile Corporate Land-Grab Payoff
debt: The character’s family owns one of the last independent ancestral properties or small workshops in a slum targeted for corporate arcology redevelopment.
threat: The megacorp is systematically jacking up utility fees, property protection taxes, and code-violation fines to force a distress sale. They need cash to pay off the fraudulent municipal fines.

name: Black-Market Synthetic Organ Replacement
debt: The character themselves suffers from an aggressive, industrial-toxin-induced organ failure caused by working in un-shielded factory zones as a teen.
threat: Public hospitals won't treat low-tier citizens. A shady back-alley street surgeon agreed to perform the transplant, but holds the remote kill-switch until the debt is cleared.

name: Bail Money for an Arbitrary Corporate Detention
debt: A spouse or partner was rounded up in an arbitrary "slum sweep" by private security forces and placed in a privatized labor prison.
threat: In this justice system, detainees are charged daily room-and-board fees. If the "detention account" runs out of credits, the prisoner is transferred to a permanent penal labor facility.

name: The Stolen Credit Persona Ransom
debt: A syndicate hacker stole the character's clean citizen identity and credit profile, tanking their score to near-zero while taking out predatory loans in their name.
threat: The syndicate is holding the encryption keys to restore the original identity hostage. Until the ransom is paid, the character is legally classified as an "unregistered vagrant."

name: Toxic Spill Smear Campaign Defense
debt: The character was a lower-level supervisor blamed by a corporation for a catastrophic chemical/industrial accident in a residential ghetto.
threat: The corporation filed a multi-million-credit civil lawsuit to cover their own negligence. If the character cannot pay the settlement installments, they face lifetime penal labor consignment.

name: Underground Clinic Cryo-Stasis Fees
debt: After a near-fatal shooting or collapse, a loved one was placed in an illegal, low-power cryo-stasis pod in an abandoned subway basement to stall brain death.
threat: The clinic runs on bootleg power that costs thousands of credits a week in bribe money to local gang leaders and rogue engineers to keep the generators running.
